newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 9-mth oil production down 69 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 9-mth oil production down 69 pct.

text.p: Philippine domestic oil production for the first nine months of 1996 dropped by 68.8 percent to 236,713 barrels from the year-ago level of 759,630 barrels, the Department of Energy (DOE) said on Thursday.

The steep decline was due to the continued suspension of oil production from the country's biggest oil find, the West Linapacan field in the southwestern Philippines, DOE oil chief Ismael Ocampo told Reuters.
Production was suspended in January due to increasing water seepage in the wells. Linapacan produced 5,312 barrels in the first nine months of the year against 564,553 in the same 1995 period.
